exposure: pregnant women with preeclampsia risk factors vs. pregnant women with no pregnancy risk factors
cohort: 240 pregnant women, 120 with risk factors for preeclampsia (experimental group) and 120 with no pregnancy risk factors (control group).
finding: Cesarean section is the most commonly used surgical procedure to complete delivery in pregnant womens with risk factors for preeclampsia.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was more common in the group of women with risk factors for pre-eclampsia (26.7%) compared with the control group (12.5%).
